about: Corrected Bog fixtures proposed in content/pass2-bog.md (bog_high: second Supper, Tiddy prior gift as +0/+2; bog_low: Bufo and Charcoal Burner replace Scarecrow and Wobbly, Bridge Toad with two banked gains). Other ten boards unchanged from pass2-boards.json.

boards.assumptions: Two Suppers. Sable has one front-row Cordial; Lutra has one permanent Take. Wick is golden. No permanent Pounce growth is assumed: Lodger grows only during each fight. Agnes grants only F3; F4 Grizel does not join merely because she is beside Wick.
boards.economy: 62 base income. Nine bought copies (27), four climbs (24), two Suppers (6), Cordial (1) = 58, leaving 4 for refreshes before any Spoils or Lutra income.

boards.assumptions: No Supper or T4 Hunter. Nip has two Takes; Lutra one. Burner has two Pinches (+2/+2), rather than inventing permanent growth on the Burner itself. Brock retains amended 1 Attack.
boards.economy: 62 base. Seven units (21), delayed climbs (13), two 1-gold spells (2) = 36. Remaining gold may fund missed refreshes, replacements and Burner spending.

boards.assumptions: Two Suppers. Kit was summoned with Clover present, so its permanent +1/+1 also receives the standing +2/+2. Other bodies are amended base plus Supper. Mallow arrived R9 and gave Burdock +1/+1 at that End of Turn: Burdock had total 7, smaller than the Clover-buffed Kit’s 8. Committee reads all seven and grants +3 Attack each this fight.
boards.economy: 62 base. Six bought units plus one created Kit (18), climbs (24), two Suppers (6) = 48. Fourteen gold remains for refreshes and earlier replacements.

boards.assumptions: No Supper or T4. Dozey arrived R6, received Pym +2/+2 then woke R8 from 4/7 to 8/14; the second Pym Pass on R9 makes 10/16, within the +12/+12 permanent cap. F4 is empty to make B3 the Pass end. One Stash remains for the Sergeant; the earlier Stash was cashed. No Kit remains.
boards.economy: 62 base. Six units (18), delayed climbs (13); six Partner Acorns form two Stashes, one cashed for 5 and one retained. Generous remaining budget represents misses and temporary units, not free stats.

boards.assumptions: Two Suppers. Soup has four Recruit-Phase swallow procs across four turns (+4/+4). Aspic fed the Pill Bug and Posset for two turns while in front of it (+2/+2). Only five inside bodies are bought; Figgy has arrived but has no stored copy yet. Elder grants only +1/+1 on emergence; the stronger draft values are not baked in.
boards.economy: 62 base +2 Spoils +3 earlier Pie payments; two Dollop discounts save 2. Twelve bought units (36), climbs (24), two Suppers (6), refreshes (3) = 69 before discounts, paid by 67 income +2 savings. Static budget, not a claimed shop trace.

boards.assumptions: No Supper, Elder or Figgy. Soup has three once-a-turn swallow gains. Pie uses its amended 1/4 body and Belly 2. Five stored bodies; no free hidden Belly stats. The Lamp Moth release gives no combat buff, since its text is When played.
boards.economy: 62 base. Twelve bought units (36), delayed climbs (13) = 49, leaving 13 before Dollop/Pie/Nell income for misses and temporary units.

boards.assumptions: One Supper. Ranocchio has grown once in each of three earlier fights (+3/+3); Tiddy arrived R8 and buffed Bufo and Gideon once each in that fight. Corrected amended bases give Ranocchio 7/8 and Tiddy 4/7. Living mirers wait once; no extra Mire income is converted into imaginary stats.
boards.economy: 62 base. Seven bought units (21), climbs (24), Supper (3) = 48. Fourteen remains for refreshes and earlier replacements before any Bog income.

boards.assumptions: No Supper or T4 Bog. Chorus lends Mire/Bitter to adjacent Peat Cutter and Scarecrow; locks, waits, Sal damage and Snap are computed in the engine. Wobbly has no inside body.
boards.economy: 62 base. Seven bought units (21), delayed climbs (13) = 34. Twenty-eight may be spent on misses, spells whose temporary effects have ended and replacements.

boards.assumptions: Two Suppers. Thanked Hob, Lob and Silky on R8: three +2/+2 Rings. Annis kept +2 Attack and +2 Health from the prior Hearth supports. Nan adds her played Ring; a prior Sally proc fills that Ring to +4/+4. Only three occupied slots are painted, keeping Chaser at one pair; Annis adds +1 Attack to Nan and Chaser at R9 End of Turn. Shy bodies were not grown before departure.
boards.economy: 62 base +6 Shy income on R9. Ten bought cards including the three departed supports (30), climbs (24), two Suppers (6), three 1-gold thank-you spells (3) = 63, leaving 5 for refreshes.

boards.assumptions: No Supper or Silky; six bodies. Lob and Hob keep amended printed stats: 2/3 and 1/3. Prior support supplies +6 Attack total (Moss +3, Cluricaun +2, Annis +1) and +6 Health total (Moss +3, Cluricaun +3). Moss has a Nan Ring +1/+1. Only Cluricaun is painted (+1 Attack). This recomputes the draft’s overstated roughly 60 to an explicit 43 stats.
boards.economy: 62 base. Seven bought units including a sold Nan (21), delayed climbs (13) = 34; at least 28 remains for misses/replacements. Ring is from Nan, not the absent Silky.

boards.assumptions: Two Suppers. Three Nests; two empty. Chiffchaff has been played twice and both it and Jay gained +4/+4 from two previous Cuckoo EOTs; Cuckoo has since moved from F3 to B2 and Redwing to F3. Redwing reaches both Eggs, so full stats 9/10 and 9/9 apply; Tom Tit does not add Health twice. Old Tern is away with its Nest covered by Cuckoo. Goose has a prior +0/+0 beyond Supper.
boards.economy: 62 base. Eight bought units including three away Birds (24), climbs (24), two Suppers (6) = 54, leaving 8 before Swallow/Spoils income for refreshes.

boards.assumptions: One Supper. Two Nests, one covered by Burner. Chiffchaff has one play and a Pinch (+1/+1), making the away Bird 4/5; Tom Tit gives the Egg full Health, for 2/5. Old Tern is away with a covered Nest. Jack Daw steals in the fight, not in the fixture.
boards.economy: 62 base. Eight bought units (24), delayed climbs (13), Supper (3), Pinch (1) = 41; 21 remains for misses/replacements before Bird income.
